title: NetGraph Scenario Schema
description: JSON Schema for NetGraph network scenario YAML files

oneOf.description: String shorthand for a simple child risk group
Child risk group definition. 'membership', 'disabled', and 'generate' are top-level-only: define such groups at top level and reference them by name as children

attrs.description: Additional metadata for the risk group

condition.description: A single attribute condition for entity filtering

attr.description: Attribute name to evaluate (supports dot-notation for nested attributes, e.g., 'hardware.vendor')

value.description: Value to compare against (not required for exists/not_exists operators)

matchSpec.description: Match specification for filtering entities by attribute conditions

logic.description: How to combine conditions (defaults vary by context: 'or' for links/demands, 'and' for membership rules)

nodeSelector.description: Node selector with path, group_by, match, and active_only

group_by.description: Attribute name to group nodes by

mode.description: How to combine variable lists (default: cartesian)

nodeDefinition.description: Node definition - either single node, counted group, blueprint reference, or nested nodes

params.description: Parameters to pass to the blueprint

count.description: Number of nodes to create (distinguishes group from single node)

template.description: Name template using {n} placeholder for sequential numbering

nodes.description: Nested child nodes (inline hierarchy without blueprints)

risk_groups.description: Risk groups this node belongs to

pattern.description: Connection pattern between source and target sets

count.description: Number of parallel links to create

cost.description: Link cost, an integer from 1 to below 2^62

risk_groups.description: Risk groups this link belongs to

vars.description: YAML anchors and variable definitions for reuse throughout the scenario

seed.description: Master seed for reproducible random operations across the scenario

nodes.description: Node definitions (single nodes or counted groups distinguished by 'count' field)

bidirectional.description: Whether to match links in both directions

link_match.description: Filter by the link's own attributes

cost.description: Link cost, an integer from 1 to below 2^62

risk_groups.description: Risk group definitions for failure modeling. Supports string shorthand: 'GroupName' is equivalent to {name: 'GroupName'}

oneOf.description: String shorthand for simple risk group

disabled.description: Whether this risk group is disabled on load

attrs.description: Additional metadata for the risk group

membership.description: Policy-based membership rule for auto-assigning entities to this risk group

generate.description: Generate risk groups from unique attribute values

scope.description: Type of entities to group (node or link only)

group_by.description: Attribute name to group by (supports dot-notation)

name.description: Template for generated group names. Use ${value} as placeholder

expand_groups.description: Also fail every entity sharing a risk group with a failed entity

modes.description: Weighted mode list; exactly one mode is chosen per iteration.

scope.description: What entities this rule applies to

count.description: Number of entities to affect for choice mode

weight_by.description: Attribute name used for weighted sampling in choice mode

components.description: Hardware component library: component name -> definition

then.description: Without preset or model, MaxFlow asks unrestricted optimized lossless maximum flow (TE_MAXFLOW_UNLIM). Demand declarations separately default to SHORTEST_PATHS_ECMP.

failure_states.description: Failure states each case reports: converged (demands computed again on the failed network) by default; stale (the unfailed network's programs forwarded unchanged) and repair (surviving original routes) only when listed.

interaction.description: ordered (default) places demands in priority order; simultaneous forwards every demand's fixed program at once, LOSSY, sharing losses on common links.
